title: Characterize Qwen3.5 hybrid-cache compatibility
description: Qwen3.5-2B uses a hybrid cache with recurrent linear-attention state on most layers, so arbitrary token-block KV concatenation is not valid end to end. Explore compatible boundaries or restrict the method.
acceptance_criteria: Either demonstrate a correct hybrid-cache insertion mechanism or document a defensible architectural restriction.

title: Develop answer-free query-conditioned block selector
description: Find a selection signal that can choose a useful flashed KV block without access to the known answer. First test self-proposed continuation likelihood gain against the no-block baseline.
acceptance_criteria: On held-out randomized tasks, the selector ranks answer-bearing blocks above chance and improves end-to-end answer accuracy over no-flash and random-flash baselines.
notes: Categorical results strengthen need for an answer-free semantic selector: relevant block is often mid-JS. Next candidate is a flashed-cache yes/no relevance probe comparing the source key against the query target, without using the answer string.

title: Persist cold KV blocks outside GPU memory
description: Add a disk or CPU-RAM cold store with metadata and measured transfer costs; current experiment keeps candidate blocks in GPU memory only.
acceptance_criteria: Blocks can be saved, restored, inserted exactly, and benchmarked for latency and memory use on the RTX 2070 SUPER.

title: Validate exact Qwen3-1.7B KV cache surgery
description: Establish that the dense-attention target supports token-addressable KV slicing, concatenation, clone/restore, and cached continuation equivalence.
acceptance_criteria: All layers are token-addressable; split/reassembly is tensor-exact; restored branches reproduce logits exactly.
close_reason: Completed: Qwen3-1.7B has 28/28 dense token-addressable layers; exact split/reassembly and clone/restore reports are saved under outputs/phase0.

title: Separate useful perturbation from maximum output divergence
description: Investigate why mean JS/KL divergence ranks the answer-bearing block last even when that block alone fixes the answer. Compare answer-free usefulness signals.
acceptance_criteria: Document at least one answer-free metric that outperforms raw maximum divergence across multiple randomized tasks, or characterize the failure with aggregate evidence.
notes:
User-proposed leading hypothesis: reverse raw JS and rank by 1-JS (equivalently ascending JS). Test on additional held-out shuffles before adding a more elaborate selector.
Seven chat/hot-slot trials across four target values: inverse-JS top-1 recall 1/7, top-2 recall 6/7, but the 337-psi target ranked 12/12 inverse and 1/12 raw. Neither polarity consistently selects semantic relevance; aggregate saved in outputs/phase1/inverse_js_aggregate.json.
close_reason: Characterized with aggregate evidence: raw and inverse JS both fail as standalone selectors, with polarity flipping by target token geometry. Relevant flashing still fixed answer correctness in 7/7 trials.

title: Broaden needle tasks and report aggregate retrieval/correctness metrics
description: Generate multiple target identifiers, answers, distractor assignments, prompt paraphrases, and seeds rather than repeating one valve target.
acceptance_criteria: Report confidence intervals for answer accuracy, relevant-block MRR/recall, and gains over no-flash and random-flash baselines.
notes:
Added fictional history-person, book-quote speaker, and history-place task families with categorical answer scoring. First GPU matrix will use a 24-token fixed trajectory to include answer-region effects.
Six categorical trials across fictional history-person, book-quote speaker, and treaty-location families. Baseline 0/6, relevant flash 6/6, random single flash 6/72. Raw JS ranks 8,10,4,8,8,1; inverse ranks 5,3,9,5,5,12. Two-tail depth-2 recall only 1/6. Aggregate saved in outputs/phase1/diverse_task_aggregate.json.

title: Demonstrate late single-block KV insertion improves answer correctness
description: Run an exhaustive synthetic needle test where each cold block is inserted after recent-context prefill, without recomputing the recent KV.
acceptance_criteria: The relevant block changes the free-generated numeric answer from incorrect to correct, while all distractor insertions remain incorrect.
close_reason: Completed: exhaustive hot-slot chat probe saved under outputs/phase1; baseline answered 125 psi, relevant insertion answered 413 psi, and all distractors were incorrect.

title: Quantify original-position versus hot-slot semantics
description: Measure the effect of keeping cached blocks at their original positions versus remapping each candidate into the same effective hot slot near the query.
acceptance_criteria: Report correctness and selector-ranking results across randomized positions for both placement policies.
